sanity_warnings.message: Metric 'mean_position_offset_bp' always produced the same value '0' across every benchmark, algorithm, test case, and region in this report. This might be a false positive, but more likely the instrumentation is broken (e.g. add_counter(0) everywhere, an evaluator stuck on a hardcoded constant, a frozen clock). If the constant value is genuinely correct, add at least one benchmark or test case where this metric takes a different value to silence this warning. This warning cannot be disabled.

bench_aligners_curated.title: Curated correctness probes
bench_aligners_curated.description: Curated correctness probes (replaces the legacy `[simple-benchmark]` Catch2 test cases). Asserts both unique-fragment primary correctness and SEAL-style batch behaviour. On purpose evaluates one sample for very long sequence (XXL_HIFI)
